name: STABILITY TEST CHAMBER
desc: Double-Walled Laboratory Stability Test Chamber engineered for precise long-term climate testing and drug stability studies. Features a 100-liter SS inner chamber, advanced CFC-free PUF insulation, and high-precision microprocessor safety control.
features: Broad operational temperature baseline from 5°C to 60°C
Wide controlled moisture spectrum from 30% RH up to 95% RH
Ultra-precise control index maintaining ±0.2°C & ±2% RH accuracy
Optional PC Interface / Software equipped with 21 CFR Part 11 features

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Double-Walled Environmental Stability Test Chamber Workstation
specifications.Target Application: Precision Drug Stability Studies and Accelerated Aging Tests
specifications.Chamber Net Capacity: 100 Liters (100% usable layout area with 25% extra distribution space)
specifications.Chamber Cooling Mechanism: Heavy-Duty Refrigeration System equipped with high-efficiency Condenser
specifications.Insulation Core Barrier: CFC-Free High-Density PUF (Polyurethane Foam) insulation up to 80°C
specifications.Internal Chamber Material: Premium Stainless Steel (SS 304 dull finish / SS 316 option)
specifications.External Enclosure Build: Heavy GI Epoxy powder coated sheet with 7-tank pretreatment process
specifications.Primary Outer Door Design: Magnetic gasket door with spring-loaded auto door closure facility
specifications.Secondary Inner Door: Full-length Acrylic / Glass viewing door with heavy-duty latches
specifications.Thermal Sealing System: High-integrity heat and moisture resistant silicone gasket at inner door
specifications.Temperature Control Range: Broad operational baseline from 5°C to 60°C adjustable scale
specifications.Humidity Operational Range: Wide controlled moisture spectrum from 30% RH up to 95% RH
specifications.Control System Accuracy: Ultra-precise control index maintaining ±0.2°C & ±2% RH accuracy
specifications.Spatial Uniformity Index: Extreme cross-chamber equilibrium tracking at ±1°C & ±3% RH
specifications.Controller Architecture: Advanced Microprocessor-Based Digital Climate & Safety Controller
specifications.Air Circulation Method: High-CFM Motorized Blower system for perfect thermal distribution
specifications.Equipment Illumination: Imported specialized chamber lights for high visibility and human safety
specifications.Validation Integration: Labeled 50 mm diameter Porthole fitted with high-grade silicone cork
specifications.Storage Tray Infrastructure: Electro-polished Stainless Steel wire mesh trays with adjustable channels
specifications.Data Software Compliance: Optional PC Interface / Software equipped with 21 CFR Part 11 features
specifications.Standby Safety Options: Supports integration of standby refrigeration systems and data scanners
specifications.Power Supply Requirements: Standard 220 V AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug connection
specifications.Mobility & Leveling: Rests on durable nylon bullet feet with built-in screwing height adjustment
